supervisor.value: Students admitted as GTAs find a doctoral advisor in their first year, so a supervisor is not needed before admission.

funding.value: All full-time admitted PhD students receive a GTA or GRA appointment with tuition waiver, stipend and health insurance.

entry_route.value: The required degree is a bachelor's degree.
